about: Options for the DualSense Wine modules, per Steam app id, each measured on its title. The Game Feel tab shows them as a game's suggested options; what the user sets for a game wins. Keys as in app/Pad.swift PadOptions.

1593500.title: God of War
1593500.measured: 2026-10-16, NotProton pr90.23: its Sony library does not know the Edge; shown as a standard DualSense the game drives the pad itself: rumble on the motors and the lightbar. It sets no trigger effects.

2108330.title: F1 23
2108330.measured: 2026-10-15, NotProton: as an Edge the game assigned no buttons ("No preset control scheme"); as a standard DualSense full control, haptics and trigger effects. 2026-10-19, MacGameFix's modules, an Edge over Bluetooth: with Steam Input on for the game the haptics started and stopped; with it off they were as steady as on a cable. A standard DualSense over Bluetooth felt jerky at 1× and almost like the cable at 2×.

2651280.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
2651280.measured: 2026-10-18, MacGameFix's modules: haptics and trigger effects over Bluetooth and on a cable. An Edge at its own motor power felt weaker than a standard DualSense; the power at full and the haptics doubled felt the same. 2026-10-19: a standard DualSense felt the same over Bluetooth as on a cable at 1×.
